name: The Giant Doors in Blackrock Depths stay shut until Lord Incendius dies
contract: On Ascension the Giant Doors (157923, spawn 15576) toward Bael'Gar are shut, and the walkway across leads through
the inside of the closed door. Ours spawned open. The door now spawns shut and opens when Lord Incendius (9017,
spawn 47733) dies. A door that is created while Incendius is dead in that instance starts open.

steps.label: CONTROL: p is in Blackrock Depths
Join world phase 1, where Blackrock Depths is spawned
The Giant Doors are shut while Incendius lives
The Giant Doors open once Incendius is dead
